scope: Independent design review of the proposed test-only Release preservation receipt; not implementation, Q13 runtime acceptance, or unmodified-release acceptance.

findings.readOnlyBoundary: Proposal uses the published getKeyValueStorage facade plus getAllKeys/getString and public profile/transition guards; it does not initialize storage or write canonical state.
findings.volatileProjection: Only envelope revision, active-foreground-timer accumulatedForegroundMs/checkpointRevision/lastCheckpointAt, and training-session activeForegroundMs are excluded. Other required payload fields remain compared.
findings.sessionEvidence: Required facts include one-item OOD23 active session at index zero, no attempts, no draft responses, no active journal, and stable ordered item/option digests; raw identities and responses remain in memory.
findings.resultErrorPreservation: Observation remains around the existing resolveRuntimeForSession(session) promise; read/receipt failure must not change its return value or thrown error.
findings.scopeClaim: This hook runs before draft retrieval and runtime validation, so its stage proves the resolver boundary only. Ordinary UI evidence remains necessary for full resume behavior.
findings.receiptBinding: The two artifacts need separate fresh nonces, each checked against its own source/patch/build binding and expected stage. Nonces must not be compared for equality across builds.
findings.privacy: No raw values or IDs are emitted; stable hashes remain private evidence and must not be printed or published.
findings.cacheGap: App cache can disappear across install. Missing baseline receipt must fail closed; no reconstruction or alternate mutation/debugger fallback.

conditionsBeforeImplementation: Add explicit snapshot/projection schema version and bind it to the patch/tool hash.
Specify and test the exact canonical serializer for semantic projections and ordered vectors, preserving order and occurrence association.
Label evidence as exact resolver success/mismatch, not complete resume; retain ordinary UI acceptance separately.
Generate distinct fresh nonces for v23 and v24 builds and bind each receipt to its own artifact; require expected receipt paths absent before each run.
Keep hashes and comparator outputs private and safe-stage-only.
Missing, malformed, stale, unclassified, or unbound required data blocks preservation PASS.
